visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a brightly lit indoor studio decorated with pink floral arrangements and large windows. A young girl with black hair in pigtails wearing a pink dress sits at a white table with a younger boy in an orange shirt. They interact with small cakes on a tiered stand. (2) The scene shifts to an outdoor harbor area with a prominent urban skyline. The girl, now wearing a yellow dress, explores a playground with orange geometric tunnels. She looks into the camera and smiles, with the city and water visible in the background background. (3) The girl is seen caring for the younger boy in a warm, indoor setting. She feeds him a donut, and they hug affectionately. The lighting is soft and domestic, with various sweets and toys scattered around them on the table. (4) A montage sequence shows the girl playing in different locations, including a slide at a playground and a waterfront pier. Animated overlays like white cloud sketches, stars, and graphic television frames appear around her as she moves and poses for the camera. (5) Transition to a white studio background where the girl is wearing a white blouse and denim overalls. She dances and makes hand gestures toward the camera. The younger boy is also present, playing nearby or interacting with her during her performance. (6) Several shots show the girl and boy in various outfits, including a pink tulle skirt and a striped shirt. They are seen in a bedroom setting and a living room, with consistent bright and cheerful lighting throughout these different indoor scenes. (7) A series of flashback-style clips show the girl as a slightly younger child taking care of the boy when he was an infant. She is seen bottle-feeding him and cuddling him on a sofa, highlighting their long-term sibling bond. (8) The video concludes with the girl walking along a seaside boardwalk under a bright, partly cloudy sky. Final credits appear on screen against a scenic view of the Hong Kong harbor, featuring high-rise buildings and calm blue water.
